## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 437 photographic captures during July 2019. This represents the activity recorded for the site during the month. The volume should continue to be monitored through routine operational reporting so that any changes in service demand or delivery can be identified promptly.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally good. Eight image sets were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 1.8 per cent. The clinic should continue to review image capture practice and address any recurring technical problems that may affect the usability of images. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 67 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This provides a summary measure of the time taken for images to move through the grading process during July 2019. The site should continue to monitor grading turnaround alongside image quality and activity, with particular attention to any emerging variation in performance.
